channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What is a ‘nuclear briefcase’, spotted at the APEC summit?
item.description: Vladimir Putin's special briefcase - thought to carry access to nuclear weapons - made a rare appearance in Shenzhen.

item.title: Trump claims Iran is developing bioweapons: Is there any evidence?
item.description: Trump threatens to 'wipe out' Iran in case of attack as Tehran's capabilities remain unclear.

item.title: Trump calls for nuclear arms reduction at APEC summit
item.description: Trump calls for nuclear arms reduction at APEC summit

item.title: North Korea expanding uranium enrichment facility, UN nuclear watchdog says
item.description: North Korea can produce both highly enriched uranium and weapons-grade plutonium at its facilities, according to IAEA.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh and south
item.description: Material damage was reported after ​debris fell following the latest Houthi strikes launched towards Saudi Arabia.

item.title: ‘Too early’ to determine impact of US blockade on Iran, with Tehran defiant
item.description: The US blockade of Iranian ports has a crippling effect on the economy, but Tehran insists its economy can survive.

item.title: Israeli military completes ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
item.description: Hamas condemned the incursion, which the Israeli military said was to dismantle a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

item.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
item.description: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.

item.title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
item.description: Asif Merchant was found guilty in March of trying to hire undercover FBI agents as hitmen to assassinate US officials, including the president.
